subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 1: revises e, i and -an words; contrasts a and e sounds (mat, pen, leg)

show.line: a or e? Listen closely. Mat has a. Pen has e!

rounds.prompt: Listen. Leg. Is it a or e?
Listen. Mat. Is it a or e?
Is it a or e in the middle? Sort the words.

hints: a opens wide. e opens a little.
Say the word slowly. Listen to the middle.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says pen. e in the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. p, e, n. Pen!

parent_line: Can hear the difference between a and e in words like mat and pen.
